title: Current Messaging & Presence / XMPP / BOSH qualification state
evidence: Messaging & Presence dev4 qualification records semantic objects, provider discovery, intention dispatch, XMPP framing/session behavior, SocketProvider isolation and Instrumentation Mesh integration.

BOSH released evidence remains dev5 (SHA-256 072555ee2fd1ac8d02ede22d280015d0904b2db805a05d49a51c5e2c0eeebd67); GitHub source now advances as dev6 solely to repair the stale environment runner and current-version/source-provenance metadata.

BOSH dev6 environment qualification now requires exact caller-supplied Socket Provider and Instrumentation Mesh source roots, compiles the core and optional adapters, and delegates to the current tests/run.sh suite.
XMPP/BOSH adapter dev2 records fail-closed protection, XEP-0206 restart projection and separation from Instrumentation authority.

Current external Socket Provider authority is dev16 SHA-256 fe2fa086bd4f1e072b8d455e6adb4475482b8db6a35118329f6b3f6e6253c8c2; the first-class GitHub Socket Provider source tree still identifies itself as dev14 and is not treated as dev16 source.
Current external Instrumentation Mesh authority is dev8 SHA-256 47402459e658da6ddb17c65c98010c0acd0e35d43b3a0b01c8c13c835f65d624; exact first-class dev8 runtime source publication remains open.

Network Transport Intentions dev3 SHA-256 d90dc49e4799f929761e75b302ab141a3bab481efdf951cdd508491a9b18c64b and XTP dev25 SHA-256 7f6ab3d1167d5fd3131c7e6d6e9ea8d8c6115106ea9df89d41357ef56773b80b are current context; neither transfers transport authority into BOSH or Messaging.

BOSH/API Client adapter v0.1-dev1 source candidate maps the generic BoshHttpExchangeProvider seam to current BOSH dev6 and API Client v0.4.1 without importing XMPP, SocketProvider or XTP; cleartext HTTP is denied by default.
open_work: Publish the exact Socket Provider v0.1-dev16 source tree under the first-class GitHub package path and byte/revision-verify it against the Library archive before using the repo tree for dev16 qualification.
Publish the exact Instrumentation Mesh v0.1-dev8 runtime source tree as a first-class package; do not reconstruct it from older vendored copies.
Run BOSH dev6 environment qualification against exact Socket Provider dev16, Instrumentation Mesh dev8 and ooRexx r13196 source/runtime roots once those roots are available together.

Run the current provider-neutral Messaging & Presence XMPP transport fixture against the exact dev16 source tree after source publication; retain fail-closed STARTTLS until a generic same-stream upgrade route is explicitly qualified.

Execute the rebased BOSH/API Client adapter deterministic qualification under ooRexx r13196 with current BOSH dev6 and API Client v0.4.1 roots, then qualify a live HTTPS BOSH exchange through API Client.

Provide/qualify a lower API Client transport backend that uses the shared SocketProvider/selector before making any HTTPS-over-XTP claim; API Client v0.4.1 currently documents RxSock socket ownership.
Register/deploy this GitHub sphere through LLM Gopher; sphere_check currently returns SPHERE_NOT_FOUND.
